# WeWantPeace

> Real-time global conflict and security monitoring platform covering 195 countries with AI-powered analysis. Track how wars, tensions, and geopolitical crises affect you personally.

WeWantPeace aggregates news from hundreds of international RSS feeds, Telegram channels, GDELT, and ACLED databases. Events are collected every 3-5 minutes, classified by GPT-4o-mini for topic, severity, and geolocation, then clustered into actionable intelligence.

## Core Features

- [Real-time Issue Dashboard](https://www.wewantpeace.live/home): Trending global conflicts ranked by KScore, updated every 15 minutes
- [Interactive Crisis Map](https://www.wewantpeace.live/map): Live conflict map with severity-coded markers across 195 countries
- [Real-time Feed](https://www.wewantpeace.live/feed): Chronological stream of verified conflict events with AI classification
- [Tension Index](https://www.wewantpeace.live/tension): Country-level tension scores (0-100) updated every 5 minutes
- [Country Analysis](https://www.wewantpeace.live/issues/country/ua): Per-country issue timeline and tension breakdown

## Key Metrics

- **KScore (Key Impact Score)**: 0-10 score measuring how much a global issue impacts your home country. Combines event velocity, severity, source credibility, geographic proximity, security alliances, and economic ties.
- **Tension Index**: 0-100 country score from EventScore (55%), ActivityScore (35%), and Spillover (10%). Levels: Stable (0-20), Caution (20-40), Elevated (40-60), High (60-80), Extreme (80-100).
- **Severity**: 0-100 per-event score based on AI analysis of conflict intensity, casualties, and escalation potential.

## Data Sources

- 200+ international RSS news feeds (Reuters, AP, Al Jazeera, BBC, Guardian, etc.)
- 50+ Telegram channels (military analysts, OSINT, regional reporters)
- GDELT Global Database of Events, Language, and Tone
- ACLED Armed Conflict Location & Event Data
- UCDP Uppsala Conflict Data Program

## Technology

- **Frontend**: Next.js 14, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Mapbox GL
- **Backend**: FastAPI (Python), PostgreSQL, Redis, Celery
- **AI Pipeline**: GPT-4o-mini for topic classification, severity scoring, geo-extraction, and deduplication
- **Platforms**: Web (PWA), Android (TWA on Google Play), Toss Mini App

## Pricing

- **Free**: Real-time trending issues, basic tension index, KScore alerts, 1 watched country
- **Pro ($4.99/mo)**: Interactive map, 5 watched countries, KScore filtering, 30-day history
- **Pro+ ($9.99/mo)**: Unlimited countries, 90-day history, quiet hours, early access
